Australian Visa Pathways

  • Subclass 482 (TSS)

    Temporary Skill Shortage visa. Enables approved Australian businesses to sponsor skilled workers for 2 to 4 years with pathway to PR.

  • Subclass 186 (ENS)

    Employer Nomination Scheme. Direct Australian Permanent Residency for highly skilled workers nominated by their employer.

  • Subclass 494 (SESR)

    Skilled Employer Sponsored Regional. 5-year provisional visa in designated regional areas leading directly to Subclass 191 PR.

Frequently Asked Questions (2026 Guide)

Quick answers to the most common Australian visa sponsorship questions, legally verified under the Migration Act 1958.

✔ Direct Answer (BLUF): Yes. You can obtain direct Australian Permanent Residency without an employer or job offer through the Skilled Independent visa (Subclass 189) and Skilled Nominated visa (Subclass 190) under Australia's points-tested General Skilled Migration (GSM) system.

For employer-sponsored visas (Subclass 482, 186, 494), an approved Australian business nomination is mandatory.

✔ Direct Answer (BLUF): Over 500+ active Australian verified vacancies are open under Subclass 482 in 2026, led by Registered Nurses, Software Engineers, Cloud DevOps Specialists, Civil Project Engineers, and Heavy Diesel Mechanics.
✔ Direct Answer (BLUF): Entry-level warehouse jobs (pickers, packers) do NOT qualify for Subclass 482 visa sponsorship because they fall below the statutory ANZSCO Skill Level 3 requirement. However, Warehouse Managers, Logistics Analysts, and regional DAMA supervisors can be sponsored.
